name: Webcrawler
description: Fetch raw URL contents, scrape HTML with CSS selectors, extract structured data via rule sets. Served by the native Rust binary wylde-ext-webcrawler (greenfield rewrite, 4564aa8); the Python shim/handler.py is retired.

resources.description: Fetch raw URL contents, scrape HTML with CSS selectors, or extract structured data via rule sets. Read-only; egress is gated by the Gateway allowlist (orthogonal to consent).

execute.description: Run a web action against a URL. The 'action' selects fetch | scrape | extract.

actions.name: fetch
actions.description: Fetch raw URL contents (text or JSON).

actions.name: scrape
actions.description: Scrape HTML with optional CSS selectors.

actions.name: extract
actions.description: Extract structured data from HTML via a rule set.
